items.briefing:
A new study by 1Password has found that AI-generated security patches fail to properly fix software vulnerabilities about half the time. This is a timely reminder that staff should not assume AI tools automatically resolve security problems — human review remains essential. In more positive news, Australian organisations are increasingly exploring AI-powered security services, with DXC and Primary launching a local AI Zero Trust security offering.

Scamwatch continues to issue alerts relevant to Australians, so staying alert to suspicious emails, calls, and messages remains important. **Practical tip:** If your team uses AI tools to assist with IT fixes or patches, always have a qualified person verify the result before considering an issue resolved.

featured.title: Secureframe launches hosted AI server for compliance
featured.quote: Australian defence contractors can reduce compliance burden using AI-powered tools for federal obligations.
